fluff.overview: The Trike is a militarized adaptation of a common civilian three-wheeled vehicle, introduced in 2469. It represents an affordable step up from unmodified civilian transport for forces that lack access to purpose-built military ground vehicles, and is favored by mercenaries and some militia organizations.
fluff.capabilities: The Trike reaches a top speed of just under 100 kph, though it is less maneuverable than the hoverbike. Its cargo capacity is typically sacrificed to improve armor protection to levels rivaling the military-grade hoverbike. The standard armament is a heavy flamer. It is not as common in service as the minigun cycle or the hoverbike.
fluff.deployment: The Trike serves with mercenary companies and planetary militia. It is considered a versatile unit despite being less common than the hoverbike or minigun cycle.
fluff.history: The Trike entered service in 2469. Beyond its introduction date and general service pattern with mercenary and militia forces, little detailed manufacturing or operational history has been documented.
